title: Book Two · Chapter 147: The Holiday Notice
story:
The final reading activity of the term begins with a holiday notice. Miss Wu pins it beside the room door. Next term, the materials group will have two full members for the regular work. Ordinary practice will begin after school starts again.

She reads the notice aloud, then gives pupils time for questions.

“Do we need new books in the holiday?” Mei asks.

“No. Read what you have or borrow what the school permits. Do not buy a special set for this.”

“Are the two places chosen already?” another pupil asks.

“No.”

Ronan looks at the bottom of the notice. It says the full rules and practice dates will come next term.

“Can we bring our records?” he asks.

“Yes. Keep your own records safe. The school has its copies, too.”

She asks each pupil to take their own work home. Borrowed school materials go back before the room closes.

Ronan checks his folder. He finds one story sheet with the school's small mark. He returns it to the right box. His own cards and practice notes stay with him.

Mei returns her picture collection. Leo brings back two thin books. Jun checks his tree book, then keeps it in his bag. It is his.

At the door, Mei asks Miss Wu about the spoken answers.

“Will we have time to read first?”

“Yes. The exact task details will be clear before you begin.”

Mei nods. She writes that down in her own notebook.

Ronan and Leo wait until she is finished. Then the three walk to the gate.

“Two places,” Leo says.

“You keep saying that,” Mei says.

“You keep writing things.”

“I want to remember them.”

Ronan laughs. “I can do both.”

Mei looks at him, then smiles. “Then do both accurately.”

Mei speaks kindly. But accurately still makes Ronan think of the old guide. He nods before they walk on.

At home, he copies the holiday notice into his notebook. He writes NEXT TERM clearly above the two places. Beneath it he writes that the details are still to come.

Dad reads it after supper.

“What can you do now?”

“Read. Practise. Keep the records.”

“Then that is enough for tonight.”

Ronan wants a larger plan. He also wants the warm bread on the plate. He puts the notebook away and reaches for it.

Mum has the garden book bag on her chair. She has finished sewing the strap. Ronan asks if it is ready.

“Ready for a normal book,” she says. “Your plans may need a larger bag.”

Dad laughs and hands Ronan the bread.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

permit＝允许；exact＝确切的；detail＝细节；strap＝背带。

## 理解问题

1. 暑假是否需要买专门新书？
2. 真正规则和练习日期什么时候公布？

## 读句子

**Leo / brings back / two thin books.** Leo／归还／两本薄书。
